statement: The cut was geographic rather than fiscal: Intel protected its US sites for political and CHIPS-related reasons and used demand language to justify a choice it had already made.
mechanism: US sites carry a state shareholder relationship, CHIPS awards and congressional attention that Germany cannot match. A firm that must choose where to concentrate scarce capacity will concentrate it where the political cost of withdrawal is highest. 'Anticipated market demand' is then a face-saving formulation covering a decision taken on political grounds, which explains why the 2024 formulation was 'pause' - a word that defers blame - rather than 'cancel'. Weakest link: if US sites were slowed on the same demand grounds in the same window, the geographic story loses its distinctive prediction.

relation_to_others.note: Fiscal versus geographic constraint; separable via total capex and US site pacing
